ctx.x: She got on, and Hamp gave me up -- I'm (inaudible). the straw. set, and to end the set he had for Dinah the gave me singing He came with the first tenor player and (inaudible) The Man I Love." Instead of Dinah singing "The Man I Love," she laughed, because they were saying, "Sing it, Miss Gin," quietly, and she just laughed through it because she was high enough. Hamp wanted to know what was wrong. And he called me up in -stairs after that. audible}. I said, "I don't know."

George Jenkins was her husband. He called George. He said, "Man, I don't know about your vocalist. You talk to her. She's just my wife." Finally he called Dinah in and asked her. Gladys and Curly gone to the movie. So they got in a heated argument, Dinah and Hamp. And she (inaudible) she mad because she ain't recorded, and the least thing Hamp

said was the worst thing with Dinah right here, and Hamp don't know it. And they got in this heated argument, and finally he told her, "kiss my ass." (inaudible), and she went upstairs and got that pistol and come back down, said, you told me to kiss your ass, and put that gun right in his -- right between his nose, his eyes, over the top of his nose, and Hamp's hair turned green. I ain't never seen anybody's hair turn green.
